verdict.rationale: Groq's OpenAI-compatibility docs tell developers to use OpenAI's client libraries by passing the Groq API key to `api_key` and changing `base_url` to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, which is exactly this story. The Responses API is also described as fully compatible with OpenAI's. Groq itself calls the API only "mostly compatible", and no hands-on report confirms an unmodified client working end to end. Missing for 10: a documented list of unsupported or divergent OpenAI parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration of a drop-in swap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point an existing OpenAI SDK client at the provider by changing only the base URL and API key

citations.quote: To start using Groq with OpenAI's client libraries, pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
We designed Groq API to be mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries, making it easy to configure your existing applications to run on Groq
Groq's Responses API is fully compatible with OpenAI's Responses API
